component.name: ModSync
component.summary: Sync your Mod Organizer 2 setup across machines

description.p: ModSync keeps a Mod Organizer 2 portable instance in sync across your Steam Deck and other Linux machines using Syncthing, so the same mod list, load order and downloads are available everywhere you play.
It pairs your machines directly (peer to peer), excludes the machine-specific files so each install keeps its own correct paths, and never touches your Nexus API key.
Early development build: Syncthing core, device pairing, guided MO2 install, and the wizard/dashboard UI.
